name: sermon-slide-builder
description: Build faithful 16:9, 32:9, or exact-template sermon PowerPoints from pasted notes, files, and existing decks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn pasted or attached sermons into PowerPoints.
interface.longDescription: Sermon Slide Builder helps ChatGPT and Codex create editable 16:9, 32:9, or exact-template sermon PowerPoints from pasted text, note files, or existing decks; source authentic historic visuals; generate consistent biblical imagery; preserve pastor wording and theology; and leave tracked placeholders for pastor-supplied media.
defaultPrompt: Build a 16:9 or 32:9 PowerPoint from my pasted sermon and its SL or Slide labels.
Create consistent biblical images and build my sermon PowerPoint.
Use this existing PowerPoint as the layout and show me which images I still need to add.
